scenario.name: uploader-crash
scenario.breaks: the process that writes segments and manifests into Swarm
scenario.expectation: Nothing new reaches the feed while it is down, so the viewer spends their buffer and then waits. Once it is back the feed advances again and playback resumes, either at the live edge or by catching up to it.
